hypotheses.construction_plan: Instantiate the template T(A,B,x) twice using the two parameter assignments and take the formal sum of the instantiations: T(V,G0,p) + T(W,H0,q), reproducing the raw expression.
required_assumptions: All products are symbolic and well-formed; no commutation or analytic properties are assumed.
hypotheses.rationale: The two summands are not syntactically equal but share the same ordered three-factor structure A(x)*B(x)*A(x). They differ only through the symbols substituted for A, B, and x, making them two instances of a single parameter-dependent family.
